notes.title: NEW DLC
notes.content:
🔥 New DLC Announcement: Bloodlines of Rebellion Now Available!
Loyal subjects and brave rebels,

We’re thrilled to announce the launch of our brand new DLC, "Bloodlines of Rebellion", a dramatic new chapter in the Thronebreaker saga!
This story-driven expansion picks up where the main game left off — the kingdom is in turmoil, the crown is under threat, and YOUR choices will determine the fate of your bloodline.
[hr][/hr]🗡️ What Awaits You in Bloodlines of Rebellion?
A fresh narrative arc with hours of new gameplay, choices, and unexpected twists.

Deep political intrigue: Unmask traitors, face powerful villains, and make decisions that echo through the realm.

More impactful choices: Every decision you make shapes the destiny of your kingdom, your family, and yourself.

Multiple endings: Will you restore peace, or plunge the realm into chaos?
[hr][/hr]
Prepare for new dangers, new alliances, and the most difficult choices yet. The shadows gather, and your reign will be tested like never before.

Available now! Play the DLC and continue your legacy in the world of Thronebreaker.
[hr][/hr]Note:
If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please share your feedback in the community forum. Thank you for your support!
[hr][/hr]
Stay tuned for more updates and future content!
